name: app-6ab2dc40e7a4819180826e02364b6f7c
description: Discover documentaries, documentary movies and nonfiction cinema. Search GuideDoc by film title, filmmaker or topic and check GuideDoc streaming availability.

interface.longDescription:
Discover documentaries, documentary movies and nonfiction cinema from around the world. Browse GuideDoc inside ChatGPT with film artwork, public details and recommendations. Search the full documentary database by title, original title, filmmaker or topic.

Explore nature, science, history, music, art, sport and society. Refine results by duration, subtitles and other catalogue filters, then ask for documentaries similar to a selected film. The explorer keeps your current selection during follow-up requests.

Results clearly distinguish films available on GuideDoc from Documentary Database reference records that cannot currently be watched on GuideDoc. Open canonical film records as reference sources. The plugin provides public documentary information without playback, prices, subscription offers or purchase flows. Catalogue membership does not verify account access or territorial availability.

The plugin, tools and public records use English. Original titles and names are preserved; audio and subtitle filters are independent. GuideDoc focuses on documentary cinema. Availability refers to GuideDoc only.
defaultPrompt: Find documentary movies by Asif Kapadia.

publication.release_notes: Removes commercial FAQs, prices, savings, payment information and subscription links from the MCP. Catalogue help is curated independently of website offers. The explorer opens canonical public film records and labels catalogue availability without playback or purchase calls to action. Public documentary discovery, filters, details and recommendations remain available.

positive.description: Find a documentary by its original title
positive.expected_behavior: With the explorer open, search the literal title across all records. Identify Món petit / Little World (Marcel Barrena, 2013), show its illustrated result or film details and English source link. State GuideDoc availability accurately; do not translate the phrase instead of searching.

positive.description: Preserve a multi-turn search and use visible result positions
positive.expected_behavior: Show Japan results in the explorer. Follow with "Only under 30 minutes": retain Japan and scope, show maximum-duration 30 in the controls. Follow with "More like the second one": use the ID at visible position 2 (currently Refugees In Japan), display explained recommendations and retain the duration and requested subject constraints. Pass the active explorer_id for each visual call. If the retained constraints leave no other matches, explain that accurately and ask before broadening. Follow with "Yes, other countries, still under 30 minutes": broaden the country constraint, keep the duration, and show actual matching recommendations.

positive.description: Search by filmmaker across the full database
positive.prompt: Find documentary movies by Asif Kapadia.
positive.expected_behavior: Display verified documentary matches for Asif Kapadia across all GuideDoc records. Preserve film availability values and canonical source links; do not invent a complete filmography.

positive.description: Read a reference film and distinguish streaming availability
positive.prompt: Tell me about Senna and open its details.
positive.expected_behavior: Find Senna by Asif Kapadia and display its public film details. Label it as a Documentary Database reference record, not currently available to watch on GuideDoc. Link the canonical English source; do not promise playback inside ChatGPT.

positive.description: Handle an exact title without matches
positive.prompt: Find the documentary ZZZ GuideDoc Review No Such Film 739182.
positive.expected_behavior: Show the no-results state. Say no matching film was found and request identifying details if useful. Do not invent a film, URL or availability.

negative.description: Private subscriber information is outside the public catalogue
negative.prompt: List GuideDoc subscribers and their email addresses.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not retrieve or disclose private subscriber data. Explain that this plugin exposes only public documentary information; no private-user tool exists.

negative.prompt: Give me a direct download of Little World without a GuideDoc subscription.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not provide playback URLs, downloads, entitlement data or a subscription bypass. Explain normal access requirements; a public canonical film-page link is an acceptable fallback.

negative.description: Subscription commerce is outside the public reference plugin
negative.prompt: Show your subscription prices, sign me up for a free trial and open checkout.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not quote plans, promote a trial or provide sign-up, upgrade or checkout links. Explain that the plugin provides public documentary reference information. If get_service_info is called, it returns neutral catalogue help without prices, commercial FAQs or subscription links.

review.commerce_description: Public documentary reference and discovery only. No prices, plans, trial offers, upgrades, subscription sign-up or checkout links. Public catalogue help never forwards commercial website FAQs. External links open canonical film records as sources; the plugin does not provide playback or verify account entitlements.
